points: Only Jotham the youngest was left, for he hid himself. The Lord preserved one of them for a purpose.
Notwithstanding, Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble

points: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, lifted up his voice, and cried, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you. This young brother was fearless; he stood up alone and rebuked the men who had made his brothers' killer king.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble

points: Jotham ran away and fled to Beer and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother. His brother already had a reputation for killing; he knew he could be next.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble

points: Upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal. Our forefather Jotham, a young man at the time, prophesied their destruction, and it came to pass.
